ambiguities_or_notes: свинья is rendered ‘sow’ in this maternal context, while поросеночек remains ‘little piglet/piglet.’
вперед не будет ослушиваться is rendered ‘from now on he will not disobey,’ preserving the temporal sense.
The source-verified oddity до пыли is retained literally as ‘as far as the dust’; no conjectural replacement such as ‘in the dust’ is introduced.
